restlet.description: Describe, render and back up advanced PDF/HTML templates over JSON. GET ?id= or ?scriptid= returns the template metadata plus its raw source; POST renders a saved or draft template to a PDF and merged XML against a real record; PUT backs the template's current source up to /SuiteScripts/CreativePlanning/pdf-template-backups. Called by netsuite-cli via `restlet call`; contract documented in the netsuite-pdf-designer skill.
restlet.name: CP | PDF Template RESTlet
